Rules: For each team, wins and losses are over the games played on or before the through_date, with the higher-scoring team winning each game. point_diff = points_for - points_against. win_pct = wins / (wins + losses), rounded to 3 decimals, half away from zero (3 of 5 is 0.6, 2 of 3 is 0.667, 5 of 9 is 0.556); a team with no counted games has 0.0. Rank all 8 teams best first by the exact fraction wins / (wins + losses), with 0-0 counting as 0; when that is equal, put the greater point_diff first; when that is also equal, put the team name first in alphabetical order. Ranks are positions 1 to 8, no ties. The first-ranked team is the leader; for every team, games_behind = ((leader wins - team wins) + (team losses - leader losses)) / 2, exact, a multiple of 0.5, and 0.0 for the leader. Submit season and through_date exactly as given, and all 8 rows in rank order with team names exactly as spelled above.
